_comment: Web-only strings, merged over armorhelper/i18n.py by tools/export_web.py.
The Python package is frozen, so anything the browser needs and the desktop
UI does not (tab renames, GIF speed, export history, service worker notices)
lives here. Later entries win, so a key may also override a Python string.

zh_CN.web.gifsTitle: 三张成品贴图 → 全身预览
zh_CN.web.gifsHint: 不经过 128×80 模板：按引擎的绘制顺序（腿 → 后肩 → 后臂 → 躯干 → 前肩 → 前臂 → 头）直接采样成品贴图。
zh_CN.web.gifsDrop: 把头部 / 身体 / 腿部贴图拖到对应的格子里
zh_CN.web.slot.head: 头部
zh_CN.web.templatePopoverHint: 下载的就是这张 128×80 的图
zh_CN.web.offlineReady: 已缓存，下次可离线打开
zh_CN.web.sheetWarnUnknown: 认不出 {name} 是哪个部位，请拖到对应的格子里。
zh_CN.web.sheetWarnNotColumns: {name}：宽度必须是 {cols} 的整数倍（身体贴图是 {cols} 列）。
zh_CN.web.sheetWarnNotMultiple: {name}：每格宽度必须是 {w} 的整数倍。
zh_CN.web.sheetWarnNotDivisible: {name}：每格 {cell}px 宽，与最大贴图的 {max}px 无法整除。
zh_CN.web.playerHint: 玩家贴图已内置，勾选即可叠加；在「设置」里选泰拉 Content/Images 可换成你自己的。
zh_CN.web.gifPlayerHint: 勾选后会先画上玩家本体（已内置原版玩家贴图，手机上也能用）。
zh_CN.web.packHint: 打包成 <名称>-pack-pc.zip：pack.json + Content/Images/Armor_Head_<id>.png、Armor_Legs_<id>.png、Armor/Armor_<id>.png，直接丢进 ResourcePacks 就能用。
zh_CN.web.packNoId: 文件名里没有 ID，按 0 打包；用原版命名（Armor_190.png）更稳妥。

en.web.gifsHint: No 128x80 template involved: the three finished sheets are sampled in the engine's draw order (legs → back shoulder → back arm → torso → front shoulder → front arm → head).
en.web.gifsDrop: Drop the head / body / legs textures into their slots
en.web.slot.head: Head
en.web.slotDrop: Drop here, or click to choose
en.web.templatePopoverHint: This is the 128x80 file you download
en.web.offlineReady: Cached — this page now opens offline
en.web.sheetWarnUnknown: Cannot tell what {name} is, drop it into the right slot.
en.web.sheetWarnNotColumns: {name}: the width must be a multiple of {cols} (a body sheet is {cols} columns wide).
en.web.sheetWarnBadRatio: {name}: the cells do not have the {w}:{h} aspect ratio.
en.web.sheetWarnTooSmall: {name}: too short, at least {need}px is needed.
en.web.sheetWarnNotMultiple: {name}: each cell must be a multiple of {w}px wide.
en.web.sheetWarnNotDivisible: {name}: {cell}px cells do not divide the {max}px of the largest sheet.
en.web.playerHint: The player textures are bundled, just tick it. Pick your own Content/Images in Settings to use that instead.
en.web.gifPlayerHint: When ticked the player's body is drawn first (bundled, so it also works on a phone).
en.web.packHint: Writes <name>-pack-pc.zip: pack.json plus Content/Images/Armor_Head_<id>.png, Armor_Legs_<id>.png and Armor/Armor_<id>.png — drop it into ResourcePacks and it works.
en.web.packNoId: No id in the file name, so it was packed as 0. Vanilla names (Armor_190.png) are safer.
